INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.

3. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

4. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.

   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.

   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.

6. When practising Listening for Information: Active and passive voice, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.

   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening Comprehension.

   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
